themes.description: This theme covers feedback related to existing trading functionalities, missing features, or suggestions for new tools within the app.
Covers feedback related to the ease of use, design, and overall user experience of the mobile application.
Feedback related to specific functionalities, features, or investment options available within the application.
Overall positive or negative sentiment about the platform or service without specific details related to other themes.
Captures overall positive or negative opinions about the broker or platform that do not relate to specific functional areas.
Covers feedback related to personal trading outcomes, market perceptions, investment strategies, and general satisfaction or dissatisfaction with trading results.
This theme covers issues related to account creation, KYC, and initial setup processes, including delays and difficulties.
Concerns related to data sharing, privacy breaches, account security, and potential misuse of personal or trading information.
This theme covers user requests for new features, enhancements, or missing functionalities within the application.
This theme covers complaints or suggestions related to the overall usability, convenience, and flow of the application, including mandatory steps or inconvenient design choices.
This theme covers reviews where users express dissatisfaction due to financial losses incurred while using the platform or service.
This theme covers feedback related to the application's design, layout, readability, and overall user experience.
This theme covers issues related to the results of investment applications, such as IPO allotment success rates or other investment product outcomes.
Covers reviews related to false advertising, incorrect reports, or deceptive practices.
This theme covers complaints about unexpected or unauthorized deductions, debits, or transactions from a user's account.
This theme covers complaints where trading activities do not result in expected account balances or profits, indicating fundamental issues with trade execution or balance calculation.
This theme covers suggestions for new features, requests to remove existing features, or complaints related to the user interface and overall user experience.
Concerns related to perceived unfair trading results, platform manipulation, or issues affecting profit/loss realization.
Covers issues related to the overall behavior and design of the app, including changes in existing features or general user experience.
Covers suggestions for new functionalities, improvements to existing features, or requests for additional investment options.
